skipReason.deal: contract type does not match the condition
skipReason.department: creator is not in the condition's departments
skipReason.newPartner: partner already has an approved contract
skipReason.oldPartner: partner has no approved contract yet

blocked.starter: You submitted this contract, so you cannot approve it yourself. Someone else in the reviewing group must.
blocked.notReviewer: You are not in the reviewing group of this step, so you cannot approve it.
blocked.headOnly: Only the department head can approve this step, and you are not the head of the reviewing group.

attention.title: The approval is paused: {{reason}}
attention.tellOwner: Tell the contract owner or the company admin so they can handle it.

reason.tool_failed: an automatic step failed and needs a decision
reason.missing_fact: {{keys}} is missing — fill it in on the contract, then resubmit the contract for approval
reason.missing_fact_any: Data needed to choose the approval branch is missing — complete the contract, then resubmit the contract for approval
reason.retry_exhausted: an automatic step failed after several retries
reason.job_timeout: an automatic step ran past its time limit
reason.other: the approval needs someone to decide what to do next

tool.ESIGN_DISABLED: e-signing is not turned on for the company — turn it on in {{path:flow}}, then resubmit the contract for approval
tool.ESIGN_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: the e-signing provider is not ready — check the connection in {{path:flow}}, then resubmit the contract for approval
tool.ESIGN_STATE: the contract already has an unfinished signing envelope or cannot be sent for signing now — deal with the existing envelope, then resubmit the contract for approval
tool.ESIGN_UNSUPPORTED_FILE: e-signing only accepts PDF files — upload a PDF version of the contract, then resubmit the contract for approval
tool.ESIGN_NOT_SIGNER: the sender is not a company signer — ask a company signer to resubmit the contract for approval
tool.NO_PARTNER_EMAIL: the partner has no email to sign with — add the partner email to the contract, then resubmit the contract for approval
tool.ESIGN_NODE_NO_SIGNER: the signing step has no company signer — an admin picks signers in the flow, then resubmit the contract for approval
tool.ESIGN_NODE_CONFIG_INVALID: the signing step is misconfigured — an admin fixes the flow, then resubmit the contract for approval
tool.CONTRACT_STEP_FILE_MISSING: there is no contract file at the Drafting step — the drafter attaches a file at the Drafting step, then resubmit the contract for approval
tool.CONTRACT_STEP_UPLOAD: the contract file cannot be used (file type, page count or the daily upload limit) — attach a different file at the Drafting step, then resubmit the contract for approval
tool.CONTRACT_STEP_STORAGE_OFF: the file storage is not ready to create the contract — tell the platform admin, then resubmit the contract for approval
tool.CONTRACT_PAYMENT_NO_RUN: cannot tell which run to record the payment for — tell the admin
tool.CONTRACT_PAYMENT_NO_CONTRACT: the contract to record the payment on was not found — tell the admin to check the flow
tool.CONTRACT_PAYMENT_BAD_AMOUNT: the amount paid is not valid — fix the amount at the payment step and redo this step
tool.CONTRACT_PAYMENT_NO_ACTOR: cannot tell who confirmed the payment — tell the admin
tool.CONTRACT_PAYMENT_BAD_DATE: the payment date is empty or malformed — fix the date at the payment step and redo this step
tool.CONTRACT_PAYMENT_NOT_IN_STAGE: the payment recording step only runs inside a flow with the Record payment node — tell the admin
tool.ESIGN_CONTRACT_NOT_IN_RUN: this contract does not belong to the running flow, so it cannot be sent for signing — tell the admin to check the flow
tool.CONTRACT_STEP_NO_RUN: the Create contract step only runs inside a flow — tell the admin
tool.CONTRACT_NOT_FOUND: the contract for this step was not found — tell an admin
tool.TOOL_OFF: the feature behind this automatic step is turned off for the company — an admin turns it back on, then resubmit the contract for approval
tool.NO_REAL_ACTION: this automatic step has real effects but was not allowed — an admin enables "real action" for the step in the flow
tool.INPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID: the automatic step's setup is no longer valid — an admin fixes the flow
tool.RESULT_TOO_LARGE: the automatic step returned too much data — tell an admin
tool.OUTPUT_REJECTED: the automatic step's result did not match the run state — resubmit the contract for approval; if it keeps failing tell an admin
tool.TOOL_CRASH: the automatic step hit an unexpected system error — resubmit the contract for approval; if it keeps failing tell an admin
tool.MISSING_ARG: the automatic step is missing input ({{keys}}) — an admin checks the flow setup
tool.UNKNOWN: an automatic step failed (code {{code}}) — tell an admin and give this code

reason.FLOW_GROUP_MISSING: The department {{keys}} of the flow no longer exists — add it, then resubmit the contract for approval
reason.FLOW_GROUP_MISSING_ANY: A department of the flow no longer exists — add it, then resubmit the contract for approval
reason.FLOW_INVALID: the approval flow is broken; an admin must fix it, then resubmit the contract for approval
reason.FLOW_MISSING: no approval flow is published; an admin must assign one, then resubmit the contract for approval
reason.FLOW_ROUTE_NONE: this contract has no approval process; a company admin must choose one in Company › Processes, then resubmit the contract for approval
reason.FLOW_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE: the process chosen for this contract was deleted or is not applied; a company admin must choose another in Company › Processes, then resubmit the contract for approval
reason.CANCELLED_BY_OWNER: the approval run was cancelled; resubmit the contract for approval
reason.FLOW_NOT_ASSIGNED: no approval process is assigned for this contract type; an admin must assign one in Company › Processes, then resubmit the contract for approval
reason.FLOW_REFUSED: the approval process could not start for the sender (a feature of the process is off or the sender is inactive); an admin must check Company › Processes, then resubmit the contract for approval
reason.FLOW_START_FAILED: the system could not start the approval process after several tries; resubmit the contract for approval, and tell an admin if it fails again
reason.FLOW_STARTING: the approval process has not started after 2 minutes; wait a few minutes or tell an admin
reason.RECEIVE_NO_OWNER: nobody is in charge of received contracts yet — set one in {{path:flow}}, then resubmit the contract for approval

release.MISSING: The automatic approval run was lost; the contract is waiting for an admin to check the flow and resubmit it for approval.
release.FAILED: The automatic approval run failed; the contract is waiting for an admin to check the flow and resubmit it for approval.
release.CANCELLED: The automatic approval run was cancelled; the contract is waiting for an admin to check the flow and resubmit it for approval.
release.EXPIRED: The automatic approval run expired; the contract is waiting for an admin to check the flow and resubmit it for approval.
release.COMPLETED: The automatic approval run ended without being recorded; the contract is waiting for an admin to check the flow and resubmit it for approval.
release.OTHER: The automatic approval run stopped unexpectedly; the contract is waiting for an admin to check the flow and resubmit it for approval.

approval.waitLevel1: Waiting for the person in charge to check and confirm.
approval.waitLevel2: Waiting for management approval (you cannot approve this step).

blocked.viewOnly: You can only view contracts, so you cannot confirm or approve. Ask your company administrator for permission to edit contracts.
blocked.starter: You submitted this contract, so you cannot approve it yourself. Another member of management must approve it.

notReviewer.level1: You are not allowed to confirm this contract: you are not in the confirming group (step 1). Ask your company administrator to add you to the group with permission to edit contracts.
notReviewer.level2: This contract is at or above the approval limit and needs management approval. You are not in the approving group (step 2), so you cannot approve it.

approval.rejectedNext: Fix the contract as described above, then resubmit it to continue the approval.

done.toLevel2: Confirmed — waiting for the Board of Directors to approve
done.redo: Contract sent to be read again.

errors.starter: You submitted this contract, so you cannot approve this step.
errors.notOpen: The approval step has changed — reload the page to see the latest status.
errors.changedReloaded: The approval step has changed (someone acted on it or AI is re-reading) — the latest status is now shown.
errors.quota: Today's AI actions are used up ({{limit}} per day). Try again tomorrow.
errors.runLimit: Your company already has {{max}} processes running (the maximum). Wait for one to finish and try again.
errors.notOwner: Only the contracts pack admin can do this. Please tell the contract owner.
errors.groupMissing: The flow still lacks a department, so it cannot be reopened. Add the department and try again.
errors.flowStarting: The approval process is being opened. Wait a few minutes, then reload the page; if the card still shows it as stopped, tell an admin.
errors.groupsMissing: The process uses a department your company does not have. An admin must add it (or edit the process), then try again.
errors.engineUnavailable: The process engine is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.
